providers.name: OpenID Connect
providers.notes: Use the issuer identifier from the provider discovery document. Register the exact HTTPS callback in the app-specific guide.

providers.name: Google
providers.notes: Create a Web application OAuth client. Add the exact callback URI as an authorized redirect URI. Google requires openid and profile and/or email.

providers.name: Microsoft Entra ID
providers.notes: Register a Web application and use the intended tenant/account audience. Use the concrete tenant issuer so issuer validation matches the ID token. Register the exact callback URI.

providers.name: Okta
providers.notes: Create an OIDC Web Application integration with Authorization Code enabled. Use the issuer for the intended authorization server and register the exact sign-in redirect URI.

providers.name: Auth0
providers.notes: Use the tenant issuer/domain and add the exact callback to Allowed Callback URLs. Custom domains must match the configured issuer.

providers.name: Keycloak
providers.notes: Create an OpenID Connect client and register the exact callback URI. Keep redirect URI patterns narrow.

providers.name: authentik
providers.notes: Create an OAuth2/OpenID Provider and set strict redirect URI matching. Ensure email and email_verified claims are available to the client.

providers.name: ZITADEL
providers.notes: Use Authorization Code with PKCE. Enable profile/email claims in the ID token or ensure the UserInfo endpoint returns them; exact redirect URI matching applies.

providers.name: Amazon Cognito
providers.notes: Use the user-pool issuer and configure the exact callback URL in the app client. This is the recommended updated issuer form; existing user pools can instead use https://cognito-idp.<region>.amazonaws.com/<user-pool-id>. Claim availability depends on pool attributes and scopes.

providers.name: GitLab
providers.notes: Create an OAuth application with the openid scope and register the exact callback. For self-managed GitLab, use the instance URL as issuer.

providers.name: FusionAuth
providers.notes: Create or select a FusionAuth Application, configure OAuth/OIDC, and add the exact callback to Authorized redirect URLs. Use the issuer and discovery metadata published by the intended tenant; tenant-specific discovery must resolve to the same issuer.

providers.name: OneLogin
providers.notes: Create an OpenID Connect app/connector, assign it to the intended users, and register the exact callback. Use the tenant subdomain and discovery metadata for that OneLogin instance; check its metadata for supported scopes and claims.

providers.name: PingOne
providers.notes: Create an OIDC Web App, enable Authorization Code, add the exact callback, and allow the openid/profile/email scopes. Copy the issuer/discovery URL for the specific PingOne environment; do not use wildcard redirects.

providers.name: JumpCloud
providers.notes: Create a Custom OIDC App and register the exact HTTPS callback. Use the regional issuer shown by JumpCloud: US oauth.id.jumpcloud.com, EU oauth.id.eu.jumpcloud.com, or India oauth.id.in.jumpcloud.com.

providers.name: Sign in with Apple
providers.notes: Supported by all nine native adapters as a provider-specific protocol path. Use only openid and email scopes, response_mode=form_post, the exact HTTPS callback, and a signed client-secret JWT in the token request body. PKCE and profile scope are omitted. email_verified may be a JSON boolean or the string true/false. Rotate the client-secret JWT before its maximum six-month expiry.
